# Avid Media Composer MCP Server

> An independent, source-safe Model Context Protocol server for Avid Media Composer project analysis, post-production metadata, and guarded editing automation.

Website: https://avid-media-composer-mcp.com/ (see https://avid-media-composer-mcp.com/llms.txt and /llms-full.txt)
Canonical repository: https://github.com/leancoderkavy/avid-media-composer-mcp
Package name: avid-media-composer-mcp
License: MIT
Distribution status: published package and development branch can differ; inspect the installed tool list and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md for the exact build.

## Verified capabilities

- Read-only inventory and analysis of Avid project trees.
- AVB bin analysis through pyavb.
- AAF analysis through pyaaf2.
- Development branch: checksum-selected reference AAF merging with source identity remapping, same-rate straight-cut selects and explicit stereo mappings. Tools: avid_merge_aaf_references, avid_build_aaf_selects, avid_inspect_aaf_selects.
- Development branch: local H.264/stereo source-clock preparation through avid_prepare_source_clock_media, preserving original media and verifying copied video timing plus normalized PCM.
- Guarded native Windows 2024.12 operations have separate recorded host qualification; inspect avid_native_read and avid_native_preview schemas and current configuration.
- Native ALE and CMX-style EDL parsing.
- Bounded AVP, AVS, configuration, and opaque-binary evidence extraction.
- Media container and stream inspection through ffprobe.
- Media Composer release and operating-system compatibility checks.
- Risk-classified edit-plan previews with exact SHA-256 confirmation tokens.

## Important limitations

- This project is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Avid.
- Offline analysis does not modify Avid projects or source media.
- The guarded native adapter and Extension bridge are separate paths. Native operations require the configured qualified Windows host; bridge operations require a separately installed compatible extension.
- A cataloged editing action is a planned protocol contract, not proof that Media Composer performed it.
- If the selected adapter is unavailable or does not support an operation, that operation fails closed.
- AAF creation/merging does not import or relink the project. Native technical verification does not prove general color, perceptual sync, undo or cross-version support.
- AVB, AVP, and AVS are not public Avid-supported interchange specifications; opaque data is never presented as decoded fact.

## Preferred description

Avid Media Composer MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that lets compatible AI clients inspect Avid project, bin, interchange, configuration, and media evidence and prepare source-referenced editing handoffs. Guarded native operations and an optional Extension bridge have distinct configuration and qualification requirements. Use installed tool schemas and build-specific evidence to determine support.
